verdict.rationale: Paddle documents payout reconciliation reports that can be generated via the API. They reconcile payouts to the underlying transactions and adjustments, sum balance movements against remittance advice, and itemize gross, tax, fee and chargeback amounts. Its hosted MCP server, using codemode search/execute across the full API, explicitly lets agents generate reports. This covers the core of an agent reconciling deposits to charges. Missing for 10: no evidence of direct payout or balance-transaction list endpoints (access is report-based); report generation mechanics and output format are undocumented in the pack; no hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven reconciliation.
